summative_rubric.title: How Long? How Big? — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 capstone to score each child against all 3 expectations on a 4-level scale.

rows.expectation_text: identify measurable attributes of two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects, including length, area, mass, capacity, and angle

levels.descriptor: Names 0-1 attributes consistently. Confuses mass and capacity.
Independently names all 4 attributes (length, area, mass, capacity) and picks the right one for an object.
Names multiple attributes per object AND mentions angle as a 5th attribute.

rows.expectation_text: compare several everyday objects and order them according to length, area, mass, and capacity

levels.descriptor: Compares pairs but cannot order 4+ objects. Often relies on visual judgment.
Orders 3 objects with prompts. Uses correct technique for one attribute.
Independently orders 4+ objects across all 4 attributes using correct techniques (line up, cover, balance, pour).
Orders 6+ objects accurately AND verifies with a second technique.

rows.expectation_text: read the date on a calendar, and use a calendar to identify days, weeks, months, holidays, and seasons

levels.descriptor: Cannot consistently read today's date or find days/weeks/months.
Reads today's date with prompts. Names a season or holiday.
Independently reads dates, navigates forward and backward, names a holiday and its season.
Identifies dates 2 weeks ahead and matches Canadian holidays to seasons.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during the Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 is the grade-level expectation.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape, 3-row × 4-level grid table.

summative_task_script.title: Measurement Day Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties the Lesson 5 Capstone Template, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Measure-Master certificates.
Stations 1-4 (6 min each): each child rotates through NAME, LENGTH, MASS, CALENDAR.
Station 1 NAME: pick object, write 2 attributes. Evidence for E2.1.
Station 2 LENGTH: order 4 strips. Evidence for E2.2.
Station 3 MASS: balance and order 4 objects. Evidence for E2.2.
Station 4 CALENDAR: find today, name holiday + season. Evidence for E2.3.
After: review the template with each child.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence.

evidence_per_expectation.E2.1: Look at Station 1. Did the child name 2 valid attributes per object?
evidence_per_expectation.E2.2: Look at Stations 2-3. Did the child order 4 strips and 4 objects correctly?
evidence_per_expectation.E2.3: Look at Station 4. Did the child read the date and name a holiday + season?
